title: AGENTIF: Benchmarking Instruction Following of Large Language Models in Agentic Scenarios
authors_zh: Yunjia Qi、Hao Peng、Xiaozhi Wang、Amy Xin、Youfeng Liu、Bin Xu、Lei Hou、Juanzi Li
best_for_zh: 需要使用专家题目、评审或评分信号评测推理系统的研究者。
one_line: AGENTIF turns long agent instructions from real applications into atomic constraints with auditable verifiers.
从真实 Agent 应用提取长指令与原子约束，逐项衡量模型能否完整遵循。
why: It makes expert-grounded evaluation evidence and its audit boundary visible.
inclusion_reason: The release supplies expert-authored, rubric-, judgment-, or reference-grounded evidence for evaluating reasoning systems.

title: Problem
问题
html:
General instruction-following benchmarks use short prompts with a few explicit constraints and do not represent agent settings with long tool descriptions, conditional branches, formatting rules, and cross-section dependencies. A model may understand local requirements yet omit a condition, misuse a tool, or overwrite earlier instructions.

AGENTIF collects long instructions from real agent applications and decomposes each into independently verifiable atomic constraints.

通用指令跟随基准多使用短提示和少量显式约束，无法代表真实 Agent 中上千词的工具说明、条件分支、格式规则和跨段依赖。模型可能逐条理解局部要求，却在长任务中遗漏某个条件、错误调用工具或让后续指令覆盖前文。

AGENTIF 从真实 Agent 应用中收集长指令，并将每条指令拆成可独立验证的原子约束，评价模型是否完整遵循。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: AGENTIF contains 707 human-annotated instructions from fifty real agent applications, including forty open-source GitHub agents and ten industrial workflows. Instructions average about 1,723 words and reach 15,630 words, with 8,415 constraints in total and 11.9 per task on average. Constraints are checked by code, LLM, or hybrid verifiers, and bilingual fields are released.
AGENTIF 含 707 条人工标注指令，来自 50 个真实 Agent 应用，其中 40 个为开源 GitHub Agent、10 个为工业工作流。平均指令约 1,723 词、最长 15,630 词，累计 8,415 条约束，平均每题 11.9 条。约束由代码、LLM 或混合 verifier 逐项检查，数据以中英双语字段公开。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect real applications: System instructions, tool rules, role requirements, and workflows are extracted from open and industrial agents.
  1. Extract constraints blockwise: Long instructions are segmented and atomic formatting, conditional, tool, prohibition, and cross-block requirements are extracted.
  1. Cross-validate and review: Multiple extractors cross-check constraints, and humans correct omissions, duplicates, and unverifiable items.
  1. Configure verifiers: Each criterion receives a code, LLM, or hybrid verifier; instructions, judges, tool simulations, and aggregation must be fixed.

1. 采集真实应用： 作者从开源 Agent 和工业工作流提取系统说明、工具规则、角色要求和任务流程。
  1. 分块抽取约束： 长指令先按结构分块，再识别格式、条件、工具、禁止行为和跨段依赖等原子要求。
  1. 交叉验证与人工复核： 多个抽取器交叉检查约束，人工修正遗漏、重复和不可判定条目，形成 8,415 条 gold。
  1. 配置 verifier： 每项约束匹配代码、LLM 或混合评测器；复现需固定指令版本、Judge、工具模拟和聚合规则。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Even the strongest model perfectly follows fewer than 30% of instructions. Conditional and tool constraints are hardest, and exact success declines with instruction length and constraint count. The GPT-4o criterion evaluator agrees with humans 94% of the time, supporting automated grading. However, high per-criterion agreement does not guarantee task-level correctness because one failed constraint can break strict success.
评测显示，最强模型也只能完整满足不足 30% 的长指令；条件约束和工具约束最困难，随着指令长度和约束数增加，完全通过率持续下降。GPT-4o 约束 evaluator 与人工判断的一致率达到 94%，为自动评分提供支撑。不过逐项高一致不等于整题无误，因为任一约束失败都会显著降低 strict success。

title: Novelty
新意
html: IFEval-style data use templated short constraints, while agent benchmarks focus on final task success. AGENTIF recovers system-level instructions from real applications and releases atomic criteria and verifiers. The novelty is criterion-level auditability of agent instruction following rather than more tool-use tasks.
现有 IFEval 类数据多由模板合成短约束，Agent benchmark 又主要看最终任务成功。AGENTIF 直接从真实应用恢复系统级长指令，并开放原子约束与 verifier。新意是把 Agent 指令遵循变成可逐项审计的数据对象，而不是只增加更多工具调用任务。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limitation 1: Industrial workflows are abstracted and de-identified and do not fully reproduce permissions, data, or organisations.
  1. Limitation 2: LLM verifiers can be influenced by length and wording, so critical constraints should use code or hybrid checks.
  1. Limitation 3: Public data may enter future training corpora, requiring private applications and refreshed instructions.

1. 局限1： 工业工作流经过抽象与去敏处理，仍不能完整复现真实权限、数据和组织流程。
  1. 局限2： LLM verifier 可能受回答长度与表述影响，关键约束应优先使用代码或混合检查。
  1. 局限3： 公开数据可进入未来训练语料，持续评测需保留未公开应用和新指令。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Use case 1: Evaluate whether agents satisfy tool, conditional, formatting, and safety requirements in long agent instructions.
  1. Use case 2: Use atomic constraints to train instruction-following judges or RLVR rewards and report failures by type.
  1. Use case 3: Enterprise deployment needs real permission and environment-state verifiers beyond textual rules.

1. 使用场景1： 评测 Agent 是否同时满足长系统提示中的工具、条件、格式和安全约束。
  1. 使用场景2： 用原子约束训练 instruction-following Judge 或 RLVR reward，并按类别报告失败。
  1. 使用场景3： 企业部署还需加入真实权限和环境状态 verifier，不能只依赖文本规则。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: Extract long instructions and atomic constraints from real agent applications.
  2. Method: Fifty applications, block extraction, cross-validation, human review, and multiple verifier types.
  3. Data: 707 instructions and 8,415 constraints, averaging 1,723 words and 11.9 constraints.
  4. Evidence: Best models perfectly follow under 30%; conditional and tool constraints are hardest.
  5. Reuse: Suitable for agent-instruction judges; prefer deterministic checks for critical rules.

1. 一句话定位： 从真实 Agent 应用提取长指令与原子约束，评价完整遵循。
  2. 方法抓手： 50 应用、分块抽取、交叉验证、人工复核和多类 verifier。
  3. 数据抓手： 707 条指令、8,415 条约束，平均 1,723 词与 11.9 条约束。
  4. 证据锚点： 最强模型完整遵循率不足 30%，条件与工具约束最难。
  5. 复用决定： 适合 Agent instruction Judge；关键规则优先采用确定性检查。
